itens.nome: Archival Chip - Mural of Infergon’s Birth
itens.funcao: Archival Content: An ancient mural on the island of Helgons.
itens.descricao:
Long ago, the mountains of the Russet Highlands surged and boiled, and the earth trembled violently. The Aniimo clans that lived here faced catastrophe.
Then a Helmwhelp rushed to the summit and, enduring the searing agony that engulfed its body, swallowed a Flame Flower that bloomed brightly amid the raging inferno.
The mountains returned to peace, but the Helmwhelp’s body was scorched blood-red. From then on, it could breathe roaring flames, transforming into the legendary Infergon.

itens.funcao: Contents: Sayn’s manuscript on Inferlupa.
itens.descricao: Sayn’s masterpiece. He is so proud of this manuscript, and claims it perfectly captures the Inferlupa’s true form.

itens.nome: Archival Chip - Tracks of Berylline Vale
itens.funcao: Contents: The origins of the Berylline Vale tracks and the "Perfect Racer."
itens.descricao: The right track began with a mistake. The perfect legend began with an accident.

itens.funcao: Recorded content: Tucker’s most treasured memory.
itens.descricao: Tucker, who liked to bury himself in a corner and sing, and Ron, the boy who longed for the stars and distant places... two lonely souls, meeting, were no longer alone. Yet a hundred years can sometimes be too short, and sometimes very long. To say farewell is to never meet again.

Entry: Your Observations in the Maze of Thorns.
itens.descricao: To the Thornblade guards, Princess Melloblum is the fairest blossom of their lineage, a treasure demanding meticulous protection. While all revere her, the First Lethal Thorn recognizes that this attention suffocates her. Yet these Thornblades, who wear their duty as honor, never pause to consider Melloblum’s own desires.

itens.funcao: Entry: Your Observations in the Maze of Thorns.
itens.descricao: Two little Budsquires, raised in the Maze of Thorns, knew the dangers of the outside world. Yet still, they longed to see it. Even if the thorns cut them, even if the pain made them weep, they kept reaching higher, desperate for a glimpse of the world beyond.

itens.funcao: Entry: Your Observations in the Maze of Thorns.
itens.descricao: "Banished" from the princess’s tea party, the observant Budsquires noticed Princess Melloblum’s subdued spirits. The First Lethal Thorn’s intervention, meant as protection, had only deepened her quiet distress. Where the Budsquires could release their pain in tears, the princess swallowed her tears, aware that her moods affected the entire court. The radiant figure who brought smiles to others wore none of her own.

itens.funcao: Entry: Your Observations in the Maze of Thorns.
itens.descricao: The previous Princess Melloblum had exhausted herself for her people’s happiness—a sacrifice that haunted the former First Lethal Thorn with guilt. So it trained its apprentice to become the perfect guardian: one who could detect and eliminate any danger to the princess without hesitation. But years later, it realized its mistake. "Thorns hardened by tears grow unyielding, yet lose their scent." A First Lethal Thorn that knew nothing of joy could only bring sorrow to those it sought to protect.

itens.funcao: Proof of victory over the Lethal Thorn: Thunderstorm Thornblade.
itens.descricao: The Thunderstorm Thornblade has hard thorns and a ruthless heart. She shows no mercy to her challengers in defeating them and breaking off their thorns. Perhaps she was born this way, or maybe her nature changed after she lost her brother. Once an innocent flower, it was on that rainy night she blossomed the flower of mourning in her deepest sorrow, and since then, ruthless thorns began to grow on her. Given the choice, she would have preferred to stay with her brother, remaining as a couple of ordinary Budsquires they once were, or to have started sharpening her thorn as early as possible, so she could have defended her loved ones.
